title: Provides Spatial Boundaries for the MSEP Area
text: msepBoundaries currently contains 8 spatial data frames. various combinations : Outline, combination HUC4 units 0317 0318 (“outline”) vs. Subbasins, HUC8s contained HUC4s (“subbasins”). Entire region (“full”) vs. region excluding Mississippi Sound (“land”). Entire watershed vs. within state Mississippi (“ms”). outline_full contains everything. outline_land contains everything except Mississippi Sound. outline_ms_full contains everything within state MS. outline_ms_land , without Mississippi Sound . Data frames starting subbasins follow pattern, split HUC8s.

title: Provides Spatial Boundaries for the MSEP Area
text: couple examples. First load libraries use tigris get state outlines:
code: library(msepBoundaries) library(dplyr) library(tigris) options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE) library(ggplot2)  # get the outlines of MS, AL, and LA lamsal <- states(cb = TRUE) |>      filter(NAME %in% c("Mississippi", "Alabama", "Louisiana"))

title: Provides Spatial Boundaries for the MSEP Area
text: outline entire watershed.
code: ggplot() +     geom_sf(data = outline_full,             fill = "blue",             alpha = 0.6) +     geom_sf(data = lamsal,             fill = NA) +     theme_void() +     ggtitle("Full watershed")

title: Provides Spatial Boundaries for the MSEP Area
text: Subbasins (HUC8) entire watershed.
code: ggplot() +     geom_sf(data = subbasins_full,             aes(fill = name),             alpha = 0.7) +     geom_sf(data = lamsal,             fill = NA) +     scale_fill_viridis_d() +     theme_void() +     labs(title = "Full watershed",          fill = "Subbasin")

title: Provides Spatial Boundaries for the MSEP Area
text: case want ignore large area water Mississippi Sound, restrict area state Mississippi.
code: ggplot() +     geom_sf(data = subbasins_ms_land,             aes(fill = name),             alpha = 0.7) +     geom_sf(data = lamsal,             fill = NA) +     theme_void() +     scale_fill_viridis_d() +     labs(title = "MS-only, cartographic boundaries",          fill = "Subbasin")
